declaredScope: WCAG 2.2 A/AA;31 A + 24 AA; incomplete Markdown evidence review
liveEvidenceSource: Parent-supplied cloud QA summaries; original journal/screenshots off checkout; browser/AT versions not supplied

criteria.name: Non-text Content
criteria.review: Partial historical/local evidence (H26, LREAD, LWS). Review meaningful image/chart/canvas alternatives and generated/exported content with AT. Word Sounds auditory-test alternatives may identify the exercise without revealing its answer; schema validity is not proof of adequate alternatives.

criteria.name: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.review: Partial source evidence (LAUDIO). Visible passage text is available for reviewed TTS routes; recorded speech, imported media and every exported alternative still need a human equivalence check.

criteria.name: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.review: Not tested for current release. Historical caption controls do not establish accurate, complete, synchronized captions in prerecorded playback or exports.

criteria.name: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.review: Not tested for current release. Review visual information and the adequacy of descriptive media alternatives in imported, generated and exported video.

criteria.name: Info and Relationships
criteria.review: Partial historical/source evidence (H26, LDBQ). Generated tables, diagrams, rubric/form relationships and teacher/student projections require semantic and AT review. A usable DBQ workflow alone does not establish all relationships.

criteria.name: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.review: Partial historical evidence. Check DOM and exported reading order in both comparison columns, organizers, responsive layouts and generated documents. Conflicting authored/automatic Directions sequencing is a separate cohesion concern unless an actual meaningful-sequence failure is established.

criteria.name: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.review: Partial historical evidence. Review spatial, visual and auditory instructions across all activities. The migrate/vibrate phoneme error is a content defect, not by itself a failure of this criterion.

criteria.name: Use of Color
criteria.review: Partial historical evidence (H26). Verify that correctness, selection, charts and failure states retain usable cues beyond color; ambiguous retained Math checkmarks need review rather than an automatic criterion failure.

criteria.name: Audio Control
criteria.review: Partial local evidence (LAUDIO, LWS); current release playback/control coverage pending. Preparation, synthesis, playback, text clips and persistent save are separate states. Test automatic audio, stop/pause/volume, interruptions and repeated actions; storage persistence is not itself this criterion.

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.review: Bounded positive live evidence (C6770): student Concept Sort completed by keyboard, including selective repair; DBQ completion and vocabulary traversal also worked. Local Word Sounds Cancel/Escape checks are LWS. These do not establish every tool, canvas, export or full process. F21 is not automatically a keyboard-operation failure.

criteria.name: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.review: Bounded positive live evidence (C6770): student Math draft Tab loop, cancellation and trigger-focus return worked. Vocabulary Escape worked. Nested dialogs, long-running preparation, all games and integration surfaces remain untested.

criteria.name: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.review: Not tested for current release. Inventory character shortcuts and their disabling/remapping/focus scope in games, editors and shared controls; historical Raptor Hunt source is not a current full-product result.

criteria.name: Timing Adjustable
criteria.review: Not tested for current release. Inventory user-facing time limits and justified exceptions in games, assessments and sessions. Provider request timeouts and audio preparation latency are not evidence of timing-adjustment conformance.

criteria.name: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.review: Partial historical source evidence. Test actual pause/stop/hide behavior for auto-updating, auto-advancing and moving content, including resumed and interrupted activities.

criteria.name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.review: Not tested by a current flash analysis. Reduced-motion handling and absence of known intentional flashing do not establish product-wide flash safety.

criteria.name: Bypass Blocks
criteria.review: Live candidate F22 (C6770): both Skip reading controls left eight comparison/listen controls before the passage. Verify repeated blocks, alternate bypass mechanisms and landmarks before deciding failure; destination distance alone is insufficient.

criteria.name: Page Titled
criteria.review: Partial source/historical evidence. Verify browser/document titles for routes and companion windows. A stale resource heading/topic is a metadata defect and does not alone establish a page-title failure.

criteria.name: Focus Order
criteria.review: Live candidate F21 (C6770): five Concept Sort moves sent focus to BODY and next Tab restarted at Hide cards/Reset. Completion still worked. Evaluate the resulting navigation sequence and preserved operation before a criterion determination; live Math focus return was positive.

criteria.name: Link Purpose (In Context)
criteria.review: Partial historical/source evidence. DBQ captured-provenance link gating (LDBQ) protects attribution; link purpose, surrounding context and generated/exported links still need accessible-name and human review.

criteria.name: Pointer Gestures
criteria.review: Partial historical evidence. Inventory gestures across charts, canvas editors and activities; native keyboard completion does not establish touch or single-pointer gesture alternatives.

criteria.name: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.review: Partial source evidence. Test cancellation, release-outside-target and interrupted pointer/drag actions; native click patterns do not cover custom canvas or touch handlers.

criteria.name: Label in Name
criteria.review: Partial historical/source evidence (H26). Recheck visible labels versus accessible names in current responsive, translated, icon and error states; prior label regression gates do not establish live speech-input behavior.

criteria.name: Motion Actuation
criteria.review: Applicability pending. The previous Not Applicable disposition is retained only as historical evidence. Confirm no relevant device/user-motion actuation across the declared product, embedded tools and deployment integrations before using Not Applicable.

criteria.name: Language of Page
criteria.review: Partial source evidence. Inventory page/document language in the web shell, standalone/companion pages and every generated export; source helpers do not establish the current rendered language metadata.

criteria.name: On Focus
criteria.review: Partial live/local evidence (C6770, LREAD). Vocabulary focus and traversal worked in the sampled reader. Audit all focus-triggered behavior and distinguish opening supplementary help from an unexpected change of context.

criteria.name: On Input
criteria.review: Partial historical evidence. Review selection, settings, grading and generated-form changes, including student/teacher transitions; all context changes and prior instructions remain unverified.

criteria.name: Consistent Help
criteria.review: Not tested product-wide. Inventory repeated help mechanisms and their relative placement across teacher/student processes, companion windows and loading/error states.

criteria.name: Error Identification
criteria.review: Input-error coverage pending. Test actually detected input errors, their identification and text descriptions. A silent Math/provider failure is not automatically an input-error-identification violation; API/network recovery is tracked separately.

criteria.name: Labels or Instructions
criteria.review: Partial historical/source evidence. Review form purpose, required formats and activity instructions, including Word Sounds unverified phoneme tasks. DBQ answer-like prompts and attribution defects are content concerns, not automatic label/instruction failures.

criteria.name: Redundant Entry
criteria.review: Partial live/source evidence (C6770, LSTORE). Same-session section/resource reflection isolation and reopening worked, with an explicit reload warning. Review redundant entry in complete processes; this evidence makes no durable-storage claim.

criteria.name: Name, Role, Value
criteria.review: Partial historical/local evidence (H26, LWS). Inspect rendered roles, names, values and busy/disabled states with AT in every tool. The isolated Word Sounds panel hides educator controls in the learner fixture; that is not full delivery-boundary proof.

criteria.name: Captions (Live)
criteria.review: Applicability pending. The previous Not Applicable disposition covered the identified first-party sample. Inventory every supported live audiovisual service and integration before retaining a product-wide exclusion.

criteria.name: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.review: Not tested for current release. Review synchronized description of meaningful visual information in prerecorded media and exports; narration controls alone do not prove adequacy.

criteria.name: Orientation
criteria.review: Partial historical layout evidence. Actual portrait/landscape use and orientation restrictions remain untested for current complex tools, dialogs and learner routes.

criteria.name: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.review: Partial source evidence. Inventory applicable personal/common-purpose fields and correct programmatic purpose across setup, authentication and delivery forms; labels alone are insufficient evidence.

criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.review: Known historical nonconformance (H26): 119 dark-theme nodes in ten STEM tools remain recorded, requiring a current retest. Old live 1300a2da3 UnsavedChanges text measured 3.79:1 at 11px bold; it is not a fresh6770 result. No current product-wide contrast pass or repaired-live claim is made.

criteria.name: Resize Text
criteria.review: Not tested with native browser resizing/zoom for the current release. LWS 320px and doubled root font checks are bounded fixture evidence; they do not replace true text-resize and browser-zoom review.

criteria.name: Images of Text
criteria.review: Partial source evidence. Review generated illustrations, diagrams, captions and exported slides/documents for images of text and applicable exceptions; ordinary UI text does not establish all generated outputs.

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.review: Partial historical/local layout evidence (H26, LWS). The readiness fixture fits at 320 CSS px; full reader, all tools, inner clipping, populated dialogs and complete responsive processes remain pending. Document width alone is not adequate evidence.

criteria.name: Non-text Contrast
criteria.review: Partial historical/local evidence. Measure controls, state boundaries, graphics and focus indicators in all supported themes/states, including forced colors; selected axe rules do not cover every required visual component.

criteria.name: Text Spacing
criteria.review: Partial historical evidence (H19). Current Word Sounds doubled-font checks are not full text-spacing tests. Verify effective spacing and absence of clipping/function loss in long/localized reading, forms, dialogs and exports.

criteria.name: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.review: Bounded positive live evidence (C6770): genuine Tab traversal across30 Original/BOTH vocabulary occurrences, popup replacement, Escape dismissal and column transition worked. Pointer hoverability/persistence, touch access and full tool coverage remain untested.

criteria.name: Multiple Ways
criteria.review: Partial source inventory (T24). Catalog groups and search offer multiple paths, but all destinations and applicable process exceptions require actual current navigation review.

criteria.name: Headings and Labels
criteria.review: Partial historical/source evidence. Review headings, labels and generated hierarchy for all 24 cards and shared routes. Resource-topic mismatch and teacher Directions conflict need human review, not automatic criterion classification.

criteria.name: Focus Visible
criteria.review: Live review candidate F21 (C6770): Concept Sort focus-to-BODY warrants focus-indicator review; it is not automatically a confirmed failure. Local readiness pending/cancel focus checks are positive. Themes, forced colors and all dynamic states remain open.

criteria.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.review: Partial local evidence (LWS); full current focus-obscuring review pending. Old 1300Word Sounds minimized-panel overlap is a historical navigation issue; determine whether a currently focused control is entirely hidden before classifying this criterion.

criteria.name: Dragging Movements
criteria.review: Partial historical/source evidence. Concept Sort/Sequence keyboard operations are positive but do not establish a single-pointer non-drag alternative. Inventory every drag action in activities, organizers, canvas editors and embedded tools.

criteria.name: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.review: Partial historical measurements. Measure current small targets/spacing and applicable exceptions across24 cards, popovers, touch controls, dialogs and exports; earlier catalog checks do not establish all targets.

criteria.name: Language of Parts
criteria.review: Partial source evidence. Review actual language changes in translated/generated passages, annotations and exported documents with a fluent reviewer. English fallbacks and BCP47 helpers do not establish all rendered language-of-parts behavior.

criteria.name: Consistent Navigation
criteria.review: Partial source/historical evidence. Review navigation across teacher/student/companion routes and preserve explicit teacher Directions sequencing. Analysis appeared in old teacher Directions; learner exposure was not established.

criteria.name: Consistent Identification
criteria.review: Partial source evidence. Review purpose-consistent names across Original/Adapted/BOTH, voice engines, prepare/play/save, generated resources and delivery routes. Historical Text Adaptation wording is a metadata issue, not automatically a criterion failure.

criteria.name: Error Suggestion
criteria.review: Detected-input-error suggestions remain untested product-wide. Local provider/Interview recovery guidance is useful usability evidence, but API failure messages alone do not establish this criterion.

criteria.name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.review: Partial source evidence (LSTORE, LDBQ). Review relevant consequential/data actions and safeguards. Old reload showed empty History/recovery while storage categories remained; permanent loss is not established, nor is a WCAG failure established solely from persistence symptoms.

criteria.name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.review: Not tested across supported authentication flows. Verify cognitive-test alternatives, password-manager/copy-paste support and deployment-specific identity behavior.401/403 errors or credential risks are not themselves accessible-authentication outcomes.

criteria.name: Status Messages
criteria.review: AT exposure not tested release-wide. LWS provides bounded local status semantics; verify actual displayed pending/progress/success/error statuses with real AT without unnecessary focus changes. Missing visual provider status is not automatically a failure; confirm qualifying status and its exposure.

catalog.label: Analyze Source Material
catalog.evidence: Teacher preparation; review hierarchy/results and learner exclusion. Current runtime coverage not established.

catalog.label: Glossary & Language Selection
catalog.evidence: C6770 reader vocabulary traversal is positive; definition/image equivalence, translation, touch and standalone glossary AT remain open.

catalog.label: Original with Supports / adaptation
catalog.evidence: C6770 Original/BOTH30-occurrence Tab/replace/Escape/column walk is positive. All modes, hover, read-aloud, reflow/zoom and exported reading remain open.

catalog.label: Word Sounds
catalog.evidence: LWS local54/58/10checks with matching hashes; current live learner audio/activities/AT and69-clip latency not established. Unverified phoneme content remains teacher-reviewed.

catalog.label: Visual Organizer
catalog.evidence: Historical organizer keyboard output is bounded. Diagram alternatives, reading order, non-drag pointer methods and current learner/export/AT paths remain open.

catalog.label: Note-Taking Templates
catalog.evidence: Historical Cornell cues are content evidence. Current form relationships, answer concealment, retention, keyboard, AT and exports remain open.

catalog.label: Anchor Charts
catalog.evidence: Generated science/content concerns are not WCAG determinations. Current image/diagram alternatives, editing and exports remain open.

catalog.label: Memory Aid Studio
catalog.evidence: Historical retrieval/confidence/self-check/transfer loop is positive pedagogy evidence. Current keyboard, audio alternatives, reveal/status and AT paths remain open.

catalog.label: Applied Challenge Studio
catalog.evidence: Historical useful output is not an accessibility pass. Current workspace ownership, form labels, revisions, recovery and AT remain open.

catalog.label: Visual Support
catalog.evidence: Current generated image quality, meaningful alternatives, decorative treatment, image-text and export equivalence remain open.

catalog.label: FAQ Generator
catalog.evidence: Historical source-grounded output is content evidence. Current disclosure keyboard/focus, hierarchy, read-aloud and AT remain open.

catalog.label: Writing Scaffolds
catalog.evidence: Historical useful frames are content evidence. Current editable-label relationships, language, focus, retained input and exports remain open.

catalog.label: Activities / discussion / simulations
catalog.evidence: Historical useful discussion output is bounded. All discussion/jigsaw and embedded simulation variants, keyboard/canvas alternatives, timing and AT remain open.

catalog.label: Interview Mode
catalog.evidence: Historical attributable-search failure; local actionable recovery does not prove live search. Current interview selection, focus, narration, source disclosure and transcript export remain open.

catalog.label: Sequence Builder
catalog.evidence: Historical keyboard reorder worked before stale-panel interruption. Current post-move focus, pointer non-drag alternative, feedback and AT remain open.

catalog.label: Concept Sort
catalog.evidence: C6770 student keyboard 3/4 → selective Fix → 4/4 completed. F21 five focus-to-BODY moves is a candidate for2.4.3/2.4.7 review, not automatic 2.1.1 failure.

catalog.label: Document-Based Question
catalog.evidence: C6770 student34/34,111-word essay,self-rating and same-session reopen worked. LDBQ attribution safeguard is local; prompt quality and provenance require educator review, not automatic WCAG classification.

catalog.label: STEAM Lab / related Math flow
catalog.evidence: C6770 studentMath draft cancel/Tab loop/focus return worked; blank Self Grade 0/2 disabled submission and retained checkmarks need review. This does not test all STEAM tools. H26 dark contrast remains historical.

catalog.label: Adventure Mode
catalog.evidence: Current branch, choices, keyboard/focus, audio alternatives, time limits and storybook output remain unverified in the supplied current summaries.

catalog.label: Assess
catalog.evidence: Current question variants, grading/repair feedback, keyboard, time limits, AT and QTI/H5P delivery remain open; generic generated schemas do not establish coverage.

catalog.label: Lesson Plan
catalog.evidence: LDBQ structural learner projection/teacher-print evidence is local; mixed narrative fields remain limited. Current teacher/student boundary, tables, sequencing and export AT remain open.

catalog.label: Assignment Directions & Goals
catalog.evidence: Old teacher Directions contradicted authored sequence with a quest map; actual student exposure was not verified. Current navigation coherence, labels, help, focus and learner filtering remain open.

catalog.label: Preview, Package & Deliver
catalog.evidence: LWSmocktransport and learner-panel fixture checks are bounded. Actual destination/device delivery, full teacher-only filtering, reopen, authentication and every output format remain open.

catalog.label: Standards & UDL Alignment
catalog.evidence: Teacher/audit artifact; current labels, results structure, evidence claims and student-boundary behavior remain open. A generated alignment report is not independent content or accessibility validation.
